title: Simple drawer tray generator
lastAssistantText:
Done. Created `index.html` — a fully self-contained, offline drawer tray maker. Open it in any browser to use.

**What's included:**

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| **Outer dimensions** | Width (80–600mm), Depth (60–400mm), Height (10–100mm) sliders |
| **Grid layout** | Columns (1–12) × Rows (1–12) |
| **Wall thickness** | 1–6mm adjustable |
| **Floor thickness** | 0.5–5mm adjustable |
| **Compartment readout** | Width, Depth, Height, Area, total count — all computed live |
| **3D preview** | Full WebGL renderer with drag-to-rotate, scroll-to-zoom, touch support |
| **Camera presets** | Top, Front, Side views + Reset |
| **Wireframe / X-Ray** | Toggle modes for inspecting internal geometry |
| **Color picker** | 6 swatches + custom color input |
| **5 presets** | Small, Medium, Large, Wide, Tall — one-click setup |
| **STL export** | Binary (recommended) and ASCII formats |
| **Material estimate** | Volume and PLA weight (1.24 g/cm³) |

**Defaults:** 180 × 120 × 30 mm with a 3 × 2 grid (6 compartments).

No dependencies, no network calls — everything is inlined. Works completely offline.
